2c247baf39.q: Why do ACL reconstruction recovery timelines vary so dramatically between patients, with some returning to sport in six months and others taking 18 months?
2c247baf39.a: The variation depends on several key factors: the tools and protocols used by the physical therapist, the mental component and drive of the patient, and how in touch patients are with their body. The NeuFit device allows patients to reconnect with their body immediately after surgery, which significantly impacts recovery speed. Additionally, the level of patient dedication to treating rehab as a full-time job for the following months, combined with the therapist's ability to manage expectations and provide clear timeline education, determines whether someone returns to sport quickly or experiences a prolonged recovery.
2c247baf39.e: Ep 138: Don't Wait Six Weeks: Prehab, Post-Op Rehab, and Return to Sport

eb450a7a04.q: When is it safe to start using the NeuFit device after ACL reconstruction surgery?
eb450a7a04.a: You can start using the NeuFit device right away, within 24 to 48 hours post-op. At the 500 hertz setting (500 pulses per second), the NeuFit provides a calming effect, decreases swelling and pain, and enhances blood flow to kickstart the healing process. You can work around surgical bandages without removing them. The sooner you begin NeuFit treatment post-operatively, the better the outcomes, as it prevents neural inhibition and atrophy that occur after surgery.
eb450a7a04.e: Ep 138: Don't Wait Six Weeks: Prehab, Post-Op Rehab, and Return to Sport

addc5dbcb1.q: What is prehab and why does pre-surgery physical therapy improve post-surgical ACL reconstruction outcomes?
addc5dbcb1.a: Prehab is physical therapy performed before surgery when there is a scheduled window before the operation. Muscles begin to atrophy within just two weeks of injury, so if surgery is scheduled several weeks out, a strict prehab program using the NeuFit device can reactivate muscles, reduce swelling, and restore range of motion before surgery. This approach significantly improves outcomes because patients emerge from surgery at a stronger baseline rather than starting from a weakened, swollen state—which would put them miles behind in their recovery trajectory.
addc5dbcb1.e: Ep 138: Don't Wait Six Weeks: Prehab, Post-Op Rehab, and Return to Sport

eb6e90c24d.q: Should post-op physical therapy wait until surgical restrictions are lifted, such as the six-week immobilization period?
eb6e90c24d.a: No. Many patients and clinicians mistakenly believe that if a surgeon says no activity for six weeks, physical therapy should not begin until six weeks post-op. However, waiting six weeks results in decreased neural connection, increased swelling, stiffness, and scar tissue development. Even within strict restrictions—such as non-weight-bearing or immobilization—there are many interventions available: quad sets, swelling and pain control, glove work, and activation of surrounding muscles. 2283ab30b5.q: Why does the vastus medialis obliquus (VMO) shut down first after ACL surgery and how does NeuFit address it?
2283ab30b5.a: Research shows that the VMO is the first muscle to shut down following a knee injury or ACL reconstruction. When the VMO loses neural connection, patella tracking becomes compromised, which creates a cascading negative effect throughout the knee. By placing a NeuFit pad directly on the VMO immediately post-op, clinicians can rapidly reestablish neural connection and prevent this domino effect, making a significant difference in knee function and recovery speed.

e3ef227d1e.q: What does the standard playbook for post-op ACL rehabilitation look like in the first three weeks?
e3ef227d1e.a: In the first three weeks post-op, the playbook typically includes glove work to the knee at 500 pulses per second to reduce swelling using lymphatic distal-to-proximal technique, which also helps with pain and neural downregulation. Immediately, one NeuFit pad is placed on the VMO and another horizontally across the rectus femoris while performing quad sets. This standard approach globally returns neural connection to the leg and lower extremity while activating the quad and VMO to prevent atrophy and establish the foundation for progression.
e3ef227d1e.e: Ep 138: Don't Wait Six Weeks: Prehab, Post-Op Rehab, and Return to Sport
